participation.context: Said the leaf stayed, and went.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Told him to leave the desk as he meant to find it.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Said she would dust round the leaf and not read it.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

story.body: You told them not to send the letter. You went out to the errand and left the loaf as it was.

title: Went out to the lodge at Holborn
